selection.guard: mean within-category/support-draw development pixel AP must not decline at 256x256 cropped ROI
selection.threshold: Image95th percentile and pixel99.5th percentile of baseline development-normal scores; separate fixed global cutoffs shared by all candidates

config.claim_scope: Bounded one-shot paired study; new verification image IDs and categories held out from this study parameter selection; some categories may have earlier prototype exposure. Not the full paper benchmark.

encoder.aggregation: raw arithmetic block mean, then branch-specific normalization
encoder.interpolation: PIL bilinear square resize, center crop
